meta.title: Live design editor | InkyBay
meta.description: Let shoppers design their own products with text, images, clipart and more, right on your Shopify product page.

hero.title: Live design editor
hero.lead: Give shoppers a simple, powerful editor to design their own products right on your product page, with a live preview on every side.

visual.alt: InkyBay live design editor customizing a soccer jersey

benefits.title: Easy for shoppers
benefits.text: A clear, guided editor that works the same on desktop and mobile.

benefits.title: Live preview
benefits.text: Every change shows instantly on the product, side by side.

benefits.title: Every product side
benefits.text: Design the front, back, sleeves or any print area you set up.

benefits.title: Print-ready output
benefits.text: Each design arrives with the files your team needs to produce it.

details.title: Text, images and clipart in one place
details.text: Shoppers add their own text, upload photos or pick from your clipart library, then move, resize and recolor everything on the canvas.

details.title: Fonts and artwork you control
details.text: Curate the fonts, clipart and colors shoppers can use, so every design stays on brand and ready to print.

details.title: Design every side of the product
details.text: Switch between front, back, left and right in one tap. Each side has its own print area and its own preview.

quote.text: Our customers design their own jerseys in a few minutes, and the files come in ready for the press. It changed how we take custom orders.

faqs.q: Does the editor work on mobile?
faqs.a: Yes. Shoppers get the same editor on phones and tablets, with controls sized for touch.

faqs.q: Can I limit which fonts and colors shoppers use?
faqs.a: Yes. You choose the fonts, colors and clipart available for each product, so designs stay on brand.

faqs.q: Can shoppers design more than one side?
faqs.a: Yes. Every side you set up, like front, back or sleeves, gets its own print area and preview.

faqs.q: Do I need to change my theme?
faqs.a: No. The editor is added through an app embed, so there are no theme code edits.
